description: Neighbourhoods like one the user liked (crime, deprivation, income, price level and station access percentiles), optionally only cheaper ones (cheaper_by_percent lower £/m², crime no more than 10 points worse) and within max_budget for bedrooms: 'like this but cheaper / elsewhere'.

bedrooms.description: [input value] Adds a ballpark price for this size.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

cheaper.description: [option] Only areas with a £/m² price level at least cheaper_by_percent lower, and crime no more than 10 percentile points worse.
cheaper.title: Cheaper

cheaper_by_percent.description: [filter: range] With cheaper: how much lower the £/m² level is.
cheaper_by_percent.title: Cheaper By Percent

max_budget.description: [filter: range] With bedrooms or property_type: only areas whose price (the type's figure, else the ballpark) is within it.
max_budget.title: Max Budget

property_type.description: [option] The home type: estimatedPrice and the max_budget filter read the type's typical price, all sizes (the figure find_areas and get quote for it).
property_type.title: Property Type
